FEAT-6-S121.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
FEAT-6-S121.description: Implement core domain logic for two-tier consent workflow including tier transitions, validation rules, and eligibility checks for data usage. Ensure correct handling of Tier 1 (limited use) vs Tier 2 (full consent) decisions.

FEAT-6-S122.title: Consent-Gated Persistence and De-identification Enforcement
FEAT-6-S122.description: Implement enforcement layer ensuring data is only stored when appropriate consent tier is achieved. Apply HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification for non-consented or partially consented data before persistence.
